hotspots.title: House GOP Impeachment Push Against Pete Hegseth
hotspots.blurb: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth faces mounting calls for impeachment and fierce media scrutiny following reports of an altercation at Arlington National Cemetery, where a guard publicly reprimanded him and his entourage for laughing near the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. House Republicans are caught in damage control as Democrats leverage the incident to push for formal proceedings, while Hegseth remains defiant.
hotspots.affect: Combined accusations of disrespect toward fallen military personnel and an escalating legislative fight over impeachment create maximum affective tension in right-wing coverage.

hotspots.title: Italy Mass School Bomb Threats & Meloni Summit
hotspots.blurb: A massive wave of anonymous bomb threats targeting over 6,000 Italian schools prompted widespread evacuations and forced Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni to convene an emergency meeting with opposition leaders. Meloni released direct video messages assuring the public that the emails were intended to sow panic rather than cause physical harm, pledging that school schedules would not be dictated by cyber-terrorists.
hotspots.affect: The widespread disruption of public infrastructure paired with high-level government crisis management drives intense national security anxiety and political contention.

hotspots.title: Pope Leo XIV & Javier Milei Dueling Visions Clash
hotspots.blurb: Following Pope Leo XIV's departure from Argentina after a historic visit, debate has intensified over the contrast between the pontiff's social justice warnings and President Javier Milei's libertarian austerity measures. Milei was visibly overcome with emotion during the tarmac farewell, even as opposition figures and online critics seized on the Pope's speeches to challenge the administration's economic policies.
hotspots.affect: The dramatic emotional spectacle of Milei's farewell juxtaposed against deep theological and political disputes over free-market reform generates sustained ideological heat.

hotspots.title: Santiago Abascal & David Broncano TV Clash
hotspots.blurb: Vox leader Santiago Abascal's fallout with Spanish media expanded dramatically after he canceled a high-profile podcast appearance with Jordi Wild following disputes over audiovisual rights, linked to his controversial interview on RTVE's 'La Revuelta' with David Broncano. Vox accused state broadcaster TVE of withholding footage and manipulating public discourse, sparking widespread accusations of media victimization and counter-attacks from prominent media figures.
hotspots.affect: Allegations of state media censorship paired with fiery public feuds between right-wing politicians and popular content creators fuel anti-establishment grievance framing.

hotspots.title: Turning Point USA Campus Cane Attack Controversy
hotspots.blurb: Right-wing media outlets have reacted with fury to a viral video showing a suspect wearing a cape and wizard hat attacking Turning Point USA representatives and students with a cane on the University of Texas at Tyler campus. TPUSA leadership and conservative commentators cited the arrest as evidence of escalating political violence targeting conservative campus activists.
hotspots.affect: Sensationally framed viral footage of physical assault on conservative activists mobilizes intense partisan outrage and fuels narratives of anti-right persecution.
